equals.asAuthored: the pressing line, as the escape line PROPOSED in A02-HPE1 (N1)

match.equals: retains possession through the next action

entries.sentence: An escaping team's score counts only if its attack started against the pressing team pressing together (players closing down the ball and cutting off passes together; one player chasing alone usually is not), the ball gets past the marked line, and the escaping team keeps it through its next action.

restates.words: The sequence begins under established coordinated pressure, the event occurs beyond the pressing line, and the attacking team retains possession through the next action.

rulings.quote: A qualifying sequence begins when the attacking team possesses the ball while facing established, coordinated defensive pressure.
That means defenders are working in connection with one another to pressure the ball and restrict relevant passing or progression opportunities.
An isolated defender closing down the ball does not necessarily constitute coordinated pressure.
A scoring event must occur within a sequence that began under coordinated pressure.
Whose action: The attacking team's next relevant ball action following completion of the scoring event.
The approved condition should recognize a successful continuation of attacking possession following the qualifying advancement event, without prescribing the type of action.

printerOnly.label: PROPOSED
printerOnly.sentence: Place the marked line where the pressing team, working together, can just cover the width, and leave room beyond it to receive the ball and keep it.

rulings.quote: Where a marked reference is necessary, its position should serve the intended game problem rather than become an arbitrary geometric requirement.
Regarding the pressing line, I do not want to introduce a universal distance or rigid field arrangement without justification.

printerOnly.label: CANDIDATE
printerOnly.sentence: For a quick start or restart, you may pass a ball to an escaping player near their own end, with the pressing team close enough to press straight away.

rulings.quote: Through a representative restart that recreates the relevant pressure conditions.
The coach should be free to use whichever practical starting arrangement creates recurring opportunities to encounter the intended problem.

printerOnly.label: CANDIDATE
printerOnly.sentence: Receiving and controlling the ball past the line is part of getting there; the next action is what follows. A player who dribbles past the line and keeps going needs to do nothing extra.

rulings.quote: Event completion: An action or reception already required to complete the original scoring event should not also count as a separate subsequent action.
For a player already carrying or dribbling, please avoid introducing an artificial extra touch, distance or time requirement simply to create a separate action.

printerOnly.label: CANDIDATE
printerOnly.sentence: No point if the ball is lost on that next action or play stops first; for an unusual stoppage, use your judgement. Judge the pressure only at the start of the attack.

rulings.quote: Successful continuation: The attacking team must retain possession through the continuation.
If play stops first: Ordinarily the continuation requirement has not been completed, so the point has not yet been earned.
Practical exceptions involving unusual stoppages should remain subject to reasonable coach judgment rather than an elaborate universal rule.
The pressure condition applies at the beginning of the qualifying sequence, not continuously throughout its entirety.

printerOnly.label: CANDIDATE
printerOnly.sentence: The pressing team can score only by winning the ball and taking it over the escaping team's end line, so pressure keeps coming; the escaping team scores only by getting past that pressure and keeping the ball.

restates.words: Pressure meaningfully compresses time, space, and available action.
Reinforce successful progression beyond coordinated pressure while maintaining attacking continuity.
The representative purpose is escape while preserving attacking continuity.

rulings.quote: I'd also like the eventual activity to make clear how coordinated pressure arises repeatedly and meaningfully within the game structure.
